sources.notes: Approved 2026-11-19 for local non-commercial use. Quirks: an object-detection dataset; only the full-screen 1920x1080 captures (file names screenshot_<unix time>, 1,158 of 2,051 images) are used, the rest are character crops; whether a capture is live play or a replay/spectator view is not verified; no publisher grant; groups are 10-minute windows of the capture time, and the 300-still sample falls in 14 windows, so few sessions; the first download also fetched 125 crops, which were deleted, never ingested and are not listed in provenance.
